VTS Scoring Log

SwissChems

US-facing gray market· Peptides, SARMs, nootropics· Scored July 2026· swisschems.is →
66 /100
Moderate Transparency
A public independent test results page using Janoshik as a named lab is a genuine differentiator. However, the 43 publicly available results do not cover the full catalog, testing consistency across peptides specifically is uneven, the specific lab is not always named on individual COAs, and COAs are not consistently linked from product pages. A mixed transparency picture that is better than most but below the cleaner public database implementations in this market.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Multiple community members have independently reported verifying SARMs purity via HPLC, with results consistent with SwissChems claims. Peptide-specific independent testing is less documented in public community archives. Community-commissioned testing on SARMs is more robust than on peptides specifically.
Community Experience
SwissChems has consistent community presence and is generally referenced as reliable for SARMs. Peptide-specific community feedback is more mixed, with some members noting COA accessibility varies by product. The brand's longevity and active product verification page are cited as positive signals.
Scoring Notes
SARMs vs peptide transparency gap
SwissChems' transparency infrastructure is meaningfully stronger on the SARM side of their catalog than on peptides. The 43 published independent test results skew toward SARMs and assorted compounds. Buyers evaluating peptides specifically should note that the public evidence base for peptide-specific testing is thinner than the overall test results page implies.
Note on the brand name
Despite the name, SwissChems is a US-based operation. The "Swiss" branding implies regulatory standards and geographic origin that do not apply to the actual operation. This is not a transparency point that enters the VTS score, but it is relevant context for buyers reading brand marketing.
